$comment: Rail network record (docs/DESIGN.md#feeds-operators-and-rail-networks): the SkyTrain's track (infrastructure/), how trains run on it (operations.json, dispatch.json), its disruptions and scenarios. Its dispatch patches and track are published under data/networks/skytrain/.
name: SkyTrain
$signalling: How the network is signalled, which says what the dispatcher models (packages/transit-core/DESIGN.md#dispatcher): moving block (CBTC; OPEN-QUESTIONS #26).
$bbox: Where its track is fetched from OpenStreetMap (npm run data:osm), [west, south, east, north]: Metro Vancouver's bbox when the track was last imported, with room for new lines.
$feeds: The feeds whose track-level routes (routes.json → kind "skytrain") run on it (config/feeds/<id>/feed.json).
